exercise1.prompt: Saving a result, and the index that gets written with it.

hiddenCases.name: the row is written with two fields, so no index came along

exercise1.hint: index=False is the argument that keeps the row numbers out. Reading the first line back is what proves it worked.

questions.prompt: What does to_csv write by default that you usually do not want?
choices: The index, as an unnamed first column
questions.explain: That unnamed column comes back as "Unnamed: 0" when the file is read again, and it accumulates every time the file makes another round trip.

questions.prompt: When is index=True the right choice?
choices: When the index carries meaning, like a date or an id
questions.explain: A meaningful index is data and belongs in the file. Row numbers are not, and writing them is what makes the round trip messy.

questions.prompt: What does columns=["name", "score"] do on to_csv?
questions.explain: It selects what goes out, which is how you publish a result without publishing your working columns.
